source.title: Rebuild Suggestions to its visual reference
source.body: ## Summary Rebuild the Suggestions view to Craig's rendered visual reference with 100% visual fidelity, in light and dark. Suggestions is the dockable view that **Suggest > Add Children** opens from Hierarchy or Graph: an assistant proposes child classes for one class, and the person picks the ones to add. On 2026-09-24 Craig called the shipped view "a terrible use of space" and asked for "a nicer formatted table with simple rows and columns"; on 2026-09-27 he asked for Analysis and Context to take less vertical space, for no em dashes, and to "in all things maximize space". The reference puts three 47 pixel bands above a five column table and a 59 pixel action bar, turns Analysis and Context into floating panels that cost no height when closed, and replaces the per row status sentence with a 22 pixel pill. In a 1,642 by 1,344 window the shipped view showed four suggestions and the reference shows all ten. Today's view already has a table (built 2026-09-29) but differs from the reference throughout (**What ships today**). This issue also settles six defects in the reference, adopts five details from a later specimen of the same view, and binds the view to the shared token layer. Part of #80. This issue carries the whole specification. Craig is not keeping a local copy, so the reference is reproduced verbatim in the first 2 comments, in order and hosted at https://dwc-axiom.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/issues/82/visual-reference.html, with every state rendered as an image below. ## How to read this issue - The rendered reference is the visual source of truth: layout, spacing, type, colour tokens for both themes, borders, glyphs, order and every string. Where the shipped app differs, the app is wrong. The reference has no rendered notes; its stylesheet comments are quoted where they settle a question. - Where the reference contradicts itself, or a later design of the same element differs, the decision is under **Reference defects and decisions**. The frames carry the corrections for decisions 1 to 11 and frame 28 draws decisions 13 and 14, each named per frame; nothing else was altered. - A later specimen of this view was drawn on 2026-09-27 at 13:52, after the reference (13:40). Where it draws an element of the view differently, it governs (decisions 7 to 11); its page scaffolding does not (decision 12). What it governs is restated here. - Fixture data illustrates shape only: the targets `Fashion Merchandising` and `Textile Science`, the runs, the suggestions and their text, every count and timestamp, the `axiom:` prefix (the open ontology's namespace), the location after `·` in Existing entity, the Context details, the overlap note, the Suggest options after `Add Children`, and the assistants `GPT-5` and `Local · Llama 3.1` (decision 20). - What the reference fakes: **New run** copies the run instantly and turns Added rows into Exists, where the real one asks the assistant and the run appears when it completes. Adding flips statuses in memory, where the real view adds through `window.axiom.taxonomyAssistant.apply` with Undo, as today. The overlap note has no source in a real run and does not ship. - The tab strip at the top of every frame (`Suggestions`, `Individuals`, the theme button) belongs to the shell (#87), and the Individuals panel (frame 27) is placeholder data. In the app the view starts at the command bar, under the dock's tab. - `SuggestionWorkbench` also renders Add Parents and Find Synonyms, which take this chrome with their own wording and, for Synonyms, their two distance columns. Find Instances, saved custom suggestions and Define New use other layouts (`src/renderer/TaxonomyAssistant.tsx:351` to `:719`, `src/renderer/SuggestionsPanel.tsx:82` to `:140`) and are not covered. ## Files | File | Bytes | SHA-256 | Where | | --- | ---: | --- | --- | | `visual-reference.html` | 62,176 | `89dbb81700c3710da07e8c7fec04238dfd6d928dccec57975a6a03886beba458` | the first 2 comments, in order, between the `html` fence lines, and https://dwc-axiom.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/issues/82/visual-reference.html | | `before-shipped-2026-09-24.png` | 305,982 | `d7aa0e5f0d95ee03d6b87139ed8f2d75ae4d63214cb0a167f5898e28152be3d2` | **Before**, 2,874 by 2,352 device pixels | | `before-prototype-v1-2026-09-27.png` | 291,255 | `fd8b84eb4acb57478d85580cc57dfc559e4149cf44f3ca7d3cbc2e1ae41d43e9` | **Before**, 1,853 by 1,919 device pixels | | `capture.js` | 8,303 | `6b0e7e5af42efa57318ed4f3d1706b811547d59de2da925120f358c799239f76` | https://dwc-axiom.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/issues/82/capture.js | Pin the reference the way #57 and #65 pinned theirs: commit it unchanged to `tests/fixtures/suggestions-visual/visual-reference.html` (the folder does not exist yet; checked 2026-10-16), add `tests/fixtures/suggestions-visual/visual-reference.html -text` to `.gitattributes` beside the details and quality entries, and have the visual test check the SHA-256 before comparing anything, as `tests/e2e/details-visual.spec.ts:46` to `:51` does. The frames were rendered from that file with Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium at device scale factor 2 (every frame is twice its CSS size), `reducedMotion: "reduce"`, locale `en-US`, time zone `America/Chicago`, and an emulated colour scheme, which the reference follows through `data-theme="auto"`. `Date` is frozen at 2026-09-27 13:39:00 CDT for New run. UI text rendered in Segoe UI (Segoe UI Semibold at weight 600), because Segoe UI Variable Text is not installed on the capture machine, and monospace in Cascadia Mono (read with `CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode` on 2026-10-16); every measurement below used those fonts. `capture.js` reproduces every frame byte for byte (three consecutive runs on 2026-10-16 gave identical SHA-256 for all 57 PNGs); a third argument `raw` skips every correction. ## Before The shipped view, as Craig captured it on 2026-09-24. This is evidence of what was wrong, not a target. Its select-all checkbox draws 22 device pixels for Chromium's 13 pixel box, so the capture is at 175% (1,642 by 1,344 CSS pixels). Decoded from the horizontal rules on 2026-10-16: the shell's tab strip ends at 79 device pixels, the fixed header at 436, and the first suggestion starts at 904 (517 CSS pixels down). Each suggestion takes 333 device pixels (190 CSS), so four fit and the status sentence `An entity with this label or normalized name already exists. It will not be duplicated or moved.` repeats on every Exists row. The reference in the same 1,642 by 1,344 window (measured with decisions 1 and 2 applied): first row at 225 CSS pixels, 181.5 below its tab strip, rows 45 pixels, all ten rows ending at 675 and the action bar at 1,285. The first version of the reference, as Craig captured it on 2026-09-27 with Context sent open: The table's header rule sits at 730 of 1,919 device pixels, 38% of the capture, below count chips that repeat the filter chips, a run line that repeats the Run select, an Analysis accordion and an open three column Context band. Craig's answer, verbatim: "I like the suggestions themselves. What I don't care for is how you convey Analysis and Context. I prefer a different mode that takes less vertical space, and please DO NOT USE EM DASHES ANYWHERE. You must in all things maximize space and you have a great deal of pixel space devoted the "header"". The reference below is the version that answered it. ## Frames The reference is a whole window, so each frame is the whole viewport. Light and dark come from the emulated colour scheme. The decisions applied to each frame are in brackets. Decision 10 also changes every frame from 01 to 25 except 13 and 14, and frame 28. | # | State | Light | Dark | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 01 | Default: Fashion Merchandising, latest run, `All` [1] | | | | 02 | Keyboard focus on the first Available checkbox [1] | | | | 03 | Three of five Available rows selected; select-all mixed [1] | | | | 04 | Select all [1] | | | | 05 | Fashion Marketing and Promotion open: Available, the fixture overlap note, `Add this child` [1, 7, 11] | | | | 06 | Fashion Buying open: Exists [1, 7, 11] | | | | 07 | Merchandise Planning and Allocation open: Added [1, 7, 11] | | | | 08 | Assortment Planning selected and open [1, 11] | | | | 09 | Analysis open [1, 8] | | | | 10 | Context open [1, 7, 8] | | | | 11 | `Already exist` pressed: every checkbox and select-all disabled [1] | | | | 12 | Search `retail` [1] | | | | 13 | Search `zoology`: empty result, search wording [1] | | | | 14 | Textile Science with `Added` pressed: empty result, status wording [1] | | | | 15 | Sorted by Suggestion, ascending [1] | | | | 16 | Sorted by Status, descending [1] | | | | 17 | After `Add 2 children`: acknowledgement [1] | | | | 18 | After `New run` (time frozen): acknowledgement, the new run selected, Added rows now Exists [1] | | | | 19 | The older run, chosen in Run history [1] | | | | 20 | Second target, `2 / 2` [1] | | | | 21 | 1,000 by 800: peek withdrawn [2] | | | | 22 | 800 by 800: Definition under the label, command bar on two lines [2, 3, 9] | | | | 23 | 600 by 800: Status words withdrawn [2, 3, 9] | | | | 24 | 600 by 800, Fashion Buying open: one column identifiers, whole definition [2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 11] | | | | 25 | 375 by 800 [1, 3, 4, 9] | | | | 26 | 375 by 800, Analysis open [1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9] | | | | 27 | The Individuals tab: shell placeholder, not this view [none] | | | | 28 | Decisions 13 and 14 drawn into frame 01: `Run again`, the cached-result line, Open another view [1, 13, 14] | | | The whole page exactly as the reference renders it at 1,280 by 800, with no correction, is at https://dwc-axiom.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/issues/82/frames/00-full-page-light.png. It is 2,146 CSS pixels wide, which is decision 1. ## What the reference specifies Values are the reference's declarations; pixel sizes were measured from the corrected rendering on 2026-10-16 at 1,280 by 800 unless a width is named. ### Tokens The shared layer (#81) declares 30 of the reference's 37 tokens. I compared the computed values of both files in both colour schemes on 2026-10-16 and all 30 match, so there is no token reconciliation: the view binds to the shared declarations and keeps only the five tokens marked view-only. The reference's `--ok-bg` and `--warn-bg` hold the shared `--ok-soft` and `--warn-soft` values, so the view uses the shared names. | Token | Light | Dark | Use here | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `#fdf5e3` | `#2b2211` | Exists fill | | `--warn-border` (view-only) | `#e6cf95` | `#5a4718` | Exists border | | `--idle` | `#57606a` | `#9ba7b4` | Available pill | | `--idle-border` (view-only) | `#c6cbd1` | `#454c54` | Available dashed border | | `--bad`, `--bad-soft` | `#a4201a`, `#fdecea` | `#ff8d81`, `#3a1a17` | Unavailable pill and note (decision 15) | | `--row-hover` | `#f6f7f9` | `#161b22` | Row hover, detail row cell, open trigger | | `--row-selected` | `#eaf2fd` | `#12243a` | Selected row and its detail cell | | `--focus` | `#0b5fd0` | `#6aabff` | Focus ring | | `--shadow-pop` | `0 8px 24px rgba(27, 31, 36, .18)` | `0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55)` | Analysis and Context panels | Spacing `--sp-1` to `--sp-6` are 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 pixels, and `--sp-8` (view-only) is 32. Radii: `--r-ctl` 4, `--r-panel` 6, `--r-pill` 999. Motion: `--t-fast` 120 ms, `--t-enter` 180 ms, both `ease-out`; with reduced motion every transition and animation runs in 1 ms. Fonts: `--font` is `"Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif` at 16 pixels on 1.5 line height; `--mono` is `"Cascadia Mono", "Cascadia Code", Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace`. Control borders use `--border-strong`, as drawn. ### Layout - Three bands, the table and the action bar. Only the table region scrolls, and its column header sticks to its top. - Heights: command bar 47 (8 padding, 30 control, 8 padding, 1 rule), run bar 47, filter bar 47, column header 40.5, rows 45 for one line and 63.38 for two, action bar 59 (12, 34, 12, 1 rule). Above 900 wide the chrome above the first row is 181.5 pixels. - The command bar and run bar are `--ground`; the filter bar, column header and action bar are `--surface`. Each band has a 1 pixel `--border` bottom rule and the action bar a `--border` top rule. ### Command bar - Padding 8 by 16, 8 pixel gap, one row. Order: previous target, position, next target, `Suggest` label, kind select, assistant select, flexible space, Run history select, `New run`. - Target pager, 2 pixel gap: two 30 by 30 icon buttons (transparent 1 pixel border, 4 pixel radius, `--text-muted`, a 16 pixel chevron `#i-chev`, the previous one turned 180 degrees; hover `--row-hover` fill, `--text`, `--border` outline; disabled at either end at 0.4 opacity) named `Previous target` and `Next target`, around the position `1 / 2` (14 pixels, `--text-muted`, tabular numerals, 4 pixel side padding, `aria-live="polite"`). - `Suggest` is a 14 pixel `--text-muted` label tied to the kind select. - Selects are 30 pixels tall, 8 pixel start padding and 20 pixel end padding, `--raised`, 1 pixel `--border-strong`, 4 pixel radius, 14 pixels; hover turns the border `--text-muted`. Measured widths: kind 153, assistant 151. The assistant select has no visible label and the accessible name `Assistant`. - Run history select: accessible name `Run history`, at most 360 pixels wide, so its text truncates (frame 01 shows `9/23/2026, 2:35:46 PM · Claude · 10 suggestions, 2`). One option per run of the current target, newest first, reading ` · · suggestions, added`, with `0 added` written out. - `New run`: primary button, 30 pixels, padding 0 by 12, `--accent` fill and border, `--accent-fg`, weight 600, 6 pixel gap after a 16 pixel four point star (`#i-run`), 102.14 pixels wide. Hover `--accent-hover` fill and border. ### Run bar - Padding 8 by 16, 12 pixel gap, one row of 47 pixels at every width. - Title, an `h1`: 18 pixels on 1.35, weight 600, letter spacing -0.01em, single line with ellipsis, shrinks before anything else. `Add children to ` in `--text`, then the target's name in `--accent`. 16 pixels at 680 and below. - Analysis peek: the first paragraph of the analysis, 14 pixels `--text-muted`, single line with ellipsis, taking all leftover width. Withdrawn at 1,100 pixels and below. The reference's own comment: "the analysis peek is a bonus, not a band: it goes before anything that carries a control, and its row keeps the same height". - `Analysis` and `Context`, at the trailing edge at every width (decision 2): default buttons (30 pixels, padding 0 by 12, `--raised`, 1 pixel `--border-strong`, 4 pixel radius, 14 pixels, 6 pixel gap) led by a 16 pixel chevron, 97.52 and 96.03 wide. While its panel is open a trigger takes a `--row-hover` fill and `--text-muted` border and its chevron turns 90 degrees over 180 ms. `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` point at the panel. ### Analysis and Context panels - Each opens 6 pixels below its trigger, right edge on the trigger's right edge, `min(620px, 100vw - 32px)` wide, at most `min(60vh, 520px)` tall with its own scroll. Padding 12, `--raised`, 1 pixel `--border-strong`, 6 pixel radius, `--shadow-pop`, above the table. Entrance: 180 ms fade from 0 opacity and 2 pixels higher. Never more than 16 pixels from either window edge (decision 5). - A closed panel costs no height, and an open one moves nothing beneath it. - Title: 13 pixels, weight 600, letter spacing 0.02em, uppercase, `--text-muted`, flush with the padding (decision 8), 8 pixels above the content. - Analysis: title `Why Claude proposed these` (the run's assistant), then each paragraph of the analysis at 15 pixels on 1.6, 8 pixels apart. Measured 620 by 333.5 with the three fixture paragraphs. - Context: title `Context sent`, then a one column list, 12 pixels between fields: `Ancestors`, `Children`, `Descendants`. Each label is 13 pixels `--text-muted` directly above its value (decision 7); the value is 15 pixels, the count in bold tabular numerals, a space, then the detail. A count of zero reads `none recorded`. Measured 620 by 203.5, 54 pixels per field. - Group roles and names: `Run analysis` and `Context sent to the assistant`. - One panel at a time; opening one closes the other. A click outside both panels and both triggers closes it. Escape closes it and returns focus to its trigger. Changing target or run closes it. ### Filter bar - Padding 8 by 16, 8 pixel gap, `--surface`. Status chips on the left in a group named `Filter by status`, the search field at the trailing edge. - Chips: 28 pixels tall, padding 0 by 12, pill radius, 1 pixel `--border-strong`, `--raised`, 14 pixels `--text-muted`, 6 pixel gap before the count in tabular numerals at 0.85 opacity. `All `, `Available `, `Added `, `Already exist `; the counts come from the whole run and ignore the search. Pressed (`aria-pressed="true"`): `--accent` fill and border, `--accent-fg`, weight 600, count at full opacity. Hover on the others: `--text` with a `--text-muted` border. Measured widths in frame 01: 64.27, 94.98, 80.64, 117.97. A chip with a count of zero stays and can be pressed; it shows the empty result (frame 14). - Search: 240 pixels wide (150 at 680 and below), 30 tall, 30 pixel start padding for a 16 pixel magnifier (`#i-search`) 8 pixels in and 7 down, placeholder `Filter suggestions`, accessible name `Filter suggestions by label or definition`. It matches the label or the definition, ignoring case, on every keystroke, combined with the pressed chip. ### Table - Fixed layout, full width. Columns: 44 pixels (selection), 30% (Suggestion), the rest (Definition), 150 (Status), 44 (details). - Column header: sticky, `--surface`, 1 pixel `--border-strong` bottom rule, padding 8 by 12 (selection cell 16 start, 0 end), 13 pixels, weight 600, letter spacing 0.02em, uppercase, `--text-muted`, no wrap. Headings `Suggestion`, `Definition`, `Status`; the last column's heading is `Details`, visually hidden. The select-all checkbox (accessible name `Select all available suggestions`) sits in the first cell. - Suggestion and Status are sort buttons: 4 pixel gap, padding 2 by 4 with a 4 pixel negative start margin, 4 pixel radius, hover `--text` on a `--border` fill. A 12 pixel arrow (`#i-sort`) follows the word, hidden until that column sorts; descending turns it 180 degrees. Pressing cycles ascending, descending, then the run's own order. `aria-sort` is absent on both headers while nothing sorts; the sorted header reads `ascending` or `descending` and the other `none`. Status sorts Available, Added, Exists, with ties by label. ### Rows - One `tbody` per suggestion with the main row and its detail row. Cells: padding 8 by 12 (selection cell 16 start, 0 end), 1 pixel `--border` bottom rule, top aligned. Hover `--row-hover`; selected `--row-selected`, kept while the pointer leaves; open rows drop their bottom rule so the detail joins them. A click anywhere on the main row except a control toggles its detail. - Selection checkbox: 18 by 18, drawn by the view: 1.5 pixel `--border-strong`, 3 pixel radius, `--raised`, no margin (decision 10); hover turns the border `--accent`. Checked: `--accent` fill and border with a 10 pixel `--accent-fg` tick (the reference's `clip-path` polygon). Mixed: a 9 by 2 `--accent-fg` bar. Disabled (Added and Exists rows): `--sunken` fill and a dashed `--border` outline, so it never looks like an empty enabled box. Accessible names `Select
